manage_schedules.title: Manage schedules
manage_schedules.description: Edit or clear the device's built-in weekly schedule. Editing lets you load an existing day as a starting point (which also copies one day to others); clearing turns the chosen days fully off.

heat_schedule.title: Edit heating schedule — step 1 of 2
heat_schedule.description: Step 1: choose which days to write to, and optionally a day to copy times from. Press **Next** to set the times on the following screen (it will be pre-filled from the day you pick here). Tip: to copy one day to several, pick it under 'Start times from' and set 'Apply to' to the target days.

data_description.days_preset: Which days this schedule will be written to when you finish.
data_description.days: Only used when 'Apply to' is set to Custom.
data_description.load_from: Pick an existing day to pre-fill the next screen with its times (you can then adjust them). Leave as 'Blank' to start empty. Only days already read from the device appear here.

water_schedule.title: Edit water schedule — step 1 of 2
water_schedule.description: Step 1: choose which days to write to, and optionally a day to copy times from. Press **Next** to set the times on the following screen (it will be pre-filled from the day you pick here). Tip: to copy one day to several, pick it under 'Start times from' and set 'Apply to' to the target days.

data_description.days_preset: Which days this schedule will be written to when you finish.
data_description.days: Only used when 'Apply to' is set to Custom.
data_description.load_from: Pick an existing day to pre-fill the next screen with its times (you can then adjust them). Leave as 'Blank' to start empty. Only days already read from the device appear here.

schedule_rows.title: Set the times — step 2 of 2
schedule_rows.description: If you chose a day to start from, these rows are already pre-filled - adjust as needed. Fill only the rows you need: a row is used only if it has a time. Times are 24-hour HH:MM (e.g. 06:30, 17:00). For heating, tick Off for a setback period instead of a target temperature; for water, tick On for a hot-water period. Submitting overwrites the whole day on the device for the days you chose.

clear_heat.title: Clear heating schedule
clear_heat.description: Overwrites the chosen days with a single all-day-off (setback) period, wiping their heating schedule. Pick the days under 'Apply to'.

data.days: Custom days (only used when Apply to is Custom)

clear_water.title: Clear water schedule
clear_water.description: Overwrites the chosen days with a single all-day-off period, wiping their hot-water schedule. Pick the days under 'Apply to'.

data.days: Custom days (only used when Apply to is Custom)

schedule_sent.title: Schedule sent
schedule_sent.description: The schedule was sent to the device, and it's being re-read now. Open the **Weekly schedule** sensor (heat or water) and check its `schedule_text` attribute - within a few seconds it should show the times you just set. If it doesn't change, the device may have rejected the write. Press Submit to close.

error.no_transitions: Add at least one transition (a row with a time filled in).
error.temperature_required: A heating transition that isn't marked Off needs a temperature.
error.invalid_time: Enter times as 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 06:30 or 17:00.
error.no_days: Select at least one day, or choose a different 'Apply to' preset.
